segments.text:
V. 24.
Unleſs a grain of wheat die—The late Reſurrection of Lazarus gave our LORD a natural Occaſion of ſpeaking on this Subject. And agreeable to his infinite Knowledge, He ſingles out, from among ſo many thouſands of Seeds, almoſt the only one that dies in the Earth: And which therefore was an exceeding proper Similitude, peculiarly adapted to the Purpoſe for which he uſes it. The like is not to be found in any other Grain, except Millet, and the large Bean.
